## How the book is organized {.unnumbered}

The book has four parts: foundations, describing networks, modeling networks and
practice. Each chapter opens with what it assumes and closes with exercises and
a summary.

## Three languages {.unnumbered}

Every example appears in R, Python and JavaScript. On the website, choose a
language once and every example follows. In the printed book the three versions
are shown one after another. The three give the same answers: they call the same
engine.
